_about: v33 beat plan (script draft 8.2, the polish round, PLAN §6), in the PLAN §2 format with the v3.1/v3.2 plans' additive fields, written as deltas on the v3.2 LOCK's beat and line ids (show/reel/ep01-v32/ep01-v32-<seg>.json). Every v3.2 beat appears once (keep, cut, merge); est_s is a planning length, never a measurement. Kept lines are keep true/false; kept V.O. carries "vo": true; restored V.O. carries "restored": true with its take path; new lines carry v33-<seg>-NNNN ids; "at" retimes a kept line; moved lines carry moved_from / moves_to. Fix codes are PLAN §6's items (V1-V3, S1-S5, P1-P19). The v3.2 spine (agency-v32) is unchanged. The script is show/episodes/ep01/script.md (draft 8.2); the notes are ../script-v33-notes.md; the spec is _spec_v33.py.
